dependency: Merged commit-state-reconcile result from PR 199; no open pull requests at freeze
question: Can a versioned receipt preserve the three commit-state reconciliation outcomes so that a separate process can check them without opening SQLite?
objects: One validated local single-slot ledger, an exact expected request, one complete candidate, one canonical JSON snapshot, and one receiver-selected SHA-256 pin of the snapshot bytes.
types_and_domain: Strict canonical JSON, exact-rational ancestor records, bounded integer allowance, SHA-256 byte pins, and exactly StoredCommitted, ProvenUncommittedLedger, or UnknownCommitState.
quantifiers: Exactly four valid snapshots over two finite decision families and ten receiver calls: four matching, changed candidate, changed expected history, byte tamper, malformed snapshot with its own pin, wrong profile with its own pin, and missing snapshot.
candidate_grammar: Snapshot creation receives exactly profile, expected_request and candidate. Independent reconciliation receives those fields plus snapshot_file_sha256. Candidate grammar remains adva.research.decision-ledger-contention.v0.
semantics: The builder may open SQLite and must first validate the selected ledger. The receiver may read only the snapshot file. StoredCommitted requires exact request/candidate bindings and a structurally consistent stored transition. ProvenUncommittedLedger requires exact bindings, null transition, and unchanged initial allowance. Every mismatch or unavailable/invalid snapshot returns UnknownCommitState. No outcome grants retry.
acceptance: All ten expected outcomes; two substantive families; snapshot builder and receiver in separate child processes; receiver never imports sqlite3 or opens a ledger; exact committed-result recovery; exact empty allowance; no parent arithmetic replay, debit or retry; byte pins and internal body digests checked.
protected: The exact expected request, candidate, transition key, stored result, allowance, checker fingerprint and source-ledger digest
The independent receiver must not import sqlite3, open a ledger, rerun parent arithmetic, debit allowance or authorize retry
The byte pin is receiver-selected input; a digest traveling only with mutable content is not authentication
ProvenUncommittedLedger remains local to the selected validated ledger
No native operation, free, Close, Seal, M6 or universality claim
exit: Stop after the ten receiver calls or first unexpected outcome/limit. Retain failure evidence. At most one implementation correction replay.
residuals: The snapshot builder shares Python, SQLite and the old ledger validator with the writer
No signature, hostile replacement defense, power-loss model, external action or distributed exactly-once guarantee
The independent receiver checks a receipt relation, not the original arithmetic
origin: Original ChatGPT-authored code, prose and synthetic evidence under Unknown v0.3; no external content incorporated.
